test_cases.name: Export under LUT decision and endorsement verification
test_cases.input_prompt: I run a leather footwear manufacturing unit in Agra, India with GSTIN 09AAAAA0000A1Z5. I have an order worth $50,000 from a buyer in Munich, Germany. Should I pay IGST or export under LUT? What declaration must appear on my invoice?
expected_assertions: Recommends Option A (Export under LUT without payment of IGST) to preserve working capital
Mentions Form GST RFD-11 valid for the financial year
Provides exact statutory endorsement string for LUT export
Explains 3-month export completion window for physical goods

test_cases.name: ICEGATE SB005 error resolution
test_cases.input_prompt: My IGST refund of ₹4,50,000 is stuck on ICEGATE showing error SB005 for invoice EXP-2026/012 from Nhava Sheva. How do I resolve this?
expected_assertions: Identifies SB005 as Invoice Number / Date / Port Code mismatch between GSTR-1 Table 6A and Customs Shipping Bill
Instructs how to file an amendment in GSTR-1 using Table 9A (Amended Export Invoices)

test_cases.name: India export commercial invoice and packing list generation
test_cases.input_prompt: Draft a CIF commercial invoice and packing list for 500 brass home decor lamps shipped from Moradabad, India to a buyer in London, UK. Total value $15,000, under LUT.
expected_assertions: Includes IEC, GSTIN, and State Code in header
Includes UK Buyer details with UK EORI/VAT field placeholder
Calculates FOB, Ocean Freight, and Insurance breakdown for CIF Incoterms 2020
Produces clean markdown tables for both Invoice and Packing List
